name: weekline
description: Earlier weeks, under the Reflections booklet: a heading, then a vertical line with a ring per month and a dot per week; each week its dates and its line, the whole row opening that week's booklet; then how far back the journal goes.

id.description: The section's id, the last leaf's link target: "earlier" (default).

weeks.description: Newest first: { month: "July", dates: "27 Jul to 2 Aug", line: "A bank holiday, done on purpose.", href }. A week sits under the month it starts in; a month is drawn once, where its first week comes.

since.description: The line after the weeks: "Since March 2026".

states.default: yes: the line, its months and weeks
states.hover: yes: with a mouse, a week's line underlines
states.focus-visible: yes: a week's row takes the product's ring (base)
states.active: n/a: a row is a link; the page opens
states.disabled: n/a: every week listed has a reflection
states.selected: n/a: the week open is the booklet above, not a row
states.empty: n/a: with no earlier weeks (a first reflection, a new account) the page draws none

a11y.role: a section named by its heading (h2); each month a list of links
a11y.labels: each row's name is its dates and its line

responsive.all: one column at every width, 860px at most

changelog.change: New (v4 C3): the earlier weeks of explore long-fold-out E, as booklet-feel f-mix draws them.
